newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bouygues catches up with sector.
newsitem.headline: Bouygues catches up with sector.

text.p: Shares in building and communication group Bouygues rose sharply on Wednesday, catching up with its sector after a recent slide.

At 1249 GMT, Bouygues was up 4.60 percent at 523 francs. Bouygues has risen from 473 francs on July 18 but this followed a long slide from 607 francs in March on worries about prospects for TF1 television in which Bouygues has a majority stake.
Bouygues is set to report its first half profits on Friday August 8.

One trader said Bouygues was unjustly undervalued in comparison to its sector. Construction shares were up on Wednesday following better than expected sales at Lafarge and a forecast of significantly higher results at Ciments Francais.
"The entire building and building materials sector is well oriented following the good figures from Lafarge," said Arnaud Palliez at Deutsche bank.
